items.content:
Nobody asks for what they want. They ask for what they think you can
give them. So the job is to find the real question underneath the asked
one without making the person feel stupid for not having asked it
properly.

It is the most skilled thing I do and it is completely invisible, which
is why it is first against the wall when someone's counting positions.

summary: Finding the real question under the asked one — skilled and invisible work
title: A defence of the reference interview
